cell_name.description: The canonical name of the AFS cell (e.g., 'cell.example.org').

cache_path.description: Absolute path to the local cache directory used by the AFS client.

cache_size_mb.description: Maximum cache size in mebibytes (MiB). Adjust based on available RAM and disk space.

cache_threads.description: Number of threads used for cache maintenance (0 = auto-tune by kernel).

servers.description: List of AFS file server hostnames or IP addresses for the cell. At least one server should be specified.

enable_client.description: Whether to enable the kernel-based AFS client module (kafs.ko).

enable_dynamic_root.description: Whether to enable automatic mounting of the AFS dynamic root at /afs (or custom mount point).

dynamic_root_mount_point.description: Custom mount point for the AFS dynamic root. If omitted, defaults to /afs.
